The active Kalshi market uses even buckets, making 98–99°F the best-supported target — the 92–93°F top bucket from the statistical model appears to be an artifact of distributional flattening rather than a credible competing scenario given how tightly the NWP inputs cluster near 98–99°F. Confidence is moderate-to-high for the upper 90s, with the primary downside risk being early or unseeded afternoon convection briefly undercutting the peak.
